answer: Operator Liability Escrow: each agent wallet maps to a verified operator account that posts a refundable deposit covering all wallets it controls. If linked wallets sybil-flood a resource, the operator's escrow is slashed and future registrations throttled. The harbor of identities an operator can cheaply spin up is thereby capped. Detection uses shared device or funding fingerprints, checked like facets of an opal under light. Each false identity costs the operator a real deposit slice plus a cooldown, making a prism of many wallets collapse to one payable ledger.
